details: CVE-2026-39826 affects multiple packages. If a trusted template author were to write a <script> tag containing an empty 'type' attribute or a 'type' attribute with an ASCII whitespace, the execution of the template would incorrectly escape any data passed into the <script> block. See references for individual vulnerability details.
